hypotheses.L0_full_suffix_logit_derivative_is_exact: The analytic Layer-16-through-capped-logit derivative agrees with independent autograd to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.L1_inner8_preserves_full_logit_tangents: The exact-read 64-mode inner-rank-8 program retains at least 0.95 full-logit tangent fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.L2_inner4_preserves_full_logit_tangents: The inner-rank-4 program retains at least 0.90 full-logit tangent fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.L3_inner8_preserves_fisher_geometry: The inner-rank-8 program retains at least 0.95 probability-weighted centered-logit/Fisher fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.L4_inner8_preserves_cross_entropy_deriva: The inner-rank-8 program retains at least 0.90 true-next-token cross-entropy directional-derivative fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.L5_common_operator_is_loss_sufficient: The frozen mean local operator retains at least 0.70 cross-entropy directional-derivative fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.L6_contextual_program_materially_improve: The full 64-mode local program exceeds the mean operator's cross-entropy derivative fidelity by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.L7_loss_program_transfers_ood: Inner-rank-8 cross-entropy derivative fidelity on each OOD corpus is within 0.05 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.L8_inner8_nearly_matches_full64_on_loss: Inner-rank-8 cross-entropy derivative fidelity is within 0.05 of full-rank 64-mode fidelity on every corpus.
